title: ranunculus aquatilis subsp. heleophyllus
intro: Ranunculus aquatilis subsp. heleophyllus, commonly known as water buttercup, is a subspecies of the ranunculus aquatilis plant. It is a flowering aquatic plant used in traditional medicine, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of water buttercup are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which are believed to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. However, more research is needed to confirm the exact therapeutic benefits and bioactive constituents of this plant.
